title: Console friendly web based games. A proof of concept Android TV console app - searching for recommended games or curated list.
author: HockeyDadNinja
selftext:
Hey all with all the AI help I see a lot of people creating web based threejs games and such. I don't game on my PC and wanted to play so I have a proof of concept Android TV app that will load web based games, key / gamepad translation, etc.

The problem now is finding the games. If people here could list their favourite or even suggest their own, provided they have gamepad support and are console friendly. That would be awesome.

I'll also consider opensource games that are close but lack gamepad support - I'd just add it.

If I get a few together I can release a demo.

Cheers and thanks!

comments.author: PurchaseCommercial34
comments.body:
[itch.io](http://itch.io) lets you filter html5 games by gamepad input, that's probably the quickest way to build a first list.

one gotcha for the wrapper: browsers don't expose a connected gamepad until the player presses a button on it, so games that check for a controller once on load decide there isn't one. a "press any button" step before launching the game fixes a surprising number of "no gamepad support" games.
